gates.message: 数据可用性、覆盖率和异常检查。
gates.name: data_quality
gates.threshold: usable=true, coverage>=95%, score>=95 for pass; coverage<85% = fail

gates.message: 数据 manifest 可用，但存在缺失 K 线等需要记录的非阻断警告。
gates.name: data_manifest
gates.threshold: source in {yfinance, alpaca, sqlite}; equity only; UTC; checksum/fingerprint present; coverage>=90%; quality>=80%; no duplicate/invalid/non-positive bars or future timestamps

gates.message: 晋级证据限定在 US equity 数据谱系内，且未使用 fixture。
gates.name: evidence_scope
gates.threshold: paper candidate requires US equity evidence and no fixture fallback; auto/sqlite evidence stays research_iteration until explicitly governed

gates.message: 基础收益质量、交易边际、最大回撤和最小交易次数检查。
gates.name: backtest_survival

gates.message: 交易成本拖累和换手率检查。
gates.name: execution_cost
gates.threshold: cost drag <= max(2%, 50% of |return|), turnover <= 5000% for pass; cost drag must not exceed total return

gates.message: 回撤和最大总敞口检查。
gates.name: portfolio_risk
gates.threshold: mdd>-20%, max gross exposure<=300%; pass wants mdd>-12%, exposure<=200%

gates.message: 组合相关性、风险预算和优化权重检查。
gates.name: portfolio_allocation
gates.threshold: max pair abs correlation<0.75 for pass, <0.95 for warn

promotion_authority.message: research_gate 只输出服务层研究评估结果；paper_candidate/next_stage 不等于 paper review approval，更不等于 paper execution authorization。
